<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- The map provider's own FCT -> SPARQL query transform.
     Accepted paths are read from the actual mui:accepts SHACL shape triples,
     not copied into TypeScript or maintained as a second geographic vocabulary.
     The mui:mapBinding annotation on each SHACL property shape identifies the
     output variable populated by that constraint (lat/lng/point/wkt). -->
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0"
 xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
 xmlns:mctx="gttp://ggg.maestro.ui/context"
 xmlns:s="http://www.w3.org/2005/sparql-results#"
 exclude-result-prefixes="mctx s">
 <xsl:output method="xml" omit-xml-declaration="yes"/>
 <xsl:key name="by-subject" match="s:result" use="s:binding[@name='s']/*[1]"/>
 <xsl:variable name="sh" select="'http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#'"/>
 <xsl:variable name="rdf" select="'http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#'"/>
 <xsl:variable name="mui" select="'gttp://ggg.maestro.ecosys/ns/ui#'"/>
 <xsl:variable name="rdfs" select="'http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#'"/>

 <xsl:template match="/mctx:context">
  <xsl:variable name="focus" select="mctx:compiled/@target"/>
  <xsl:variable name="addr" select="mctx:query/*[local-name()='query']/@addr"/>
  <xsl:variable name="graph" select="substring-before($addr, '@')"/>
  <xsl:variable name="or-triple" select="(mctx:shape/s:sparql/s:results/s:result[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($sh,'or')])[1]"/>
  <xsl:variable name="or-list" select="string($or-triple/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
  <xsl:variable name="view" select="(mctx:query//*[local-name()='view'])[1]"/>
  <query-request timeout="{mctx:compiled/@timeout}" valid="{boolean($or-list != '' and count(mctx:shape/s:sparql/s:results/s:result[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($rdf,'first')]) > 0)}">
   <sparql>
    <xsl:value-of select="mctx:compiled/mctx:prefix"/>
    <!-- The earlier unbounded SELECT DISTINCT subquery materialized the entire
         FCT focus population before applying geographic constraints. Large
         Book/Person populations timed out even for LIMIT 1 eligibility probes.
         Apply the exact same compiled selection in this SELECT's WHERE so the
         graph server can optimize geographic joins and stop at the provider
         output cap. The outer DISTINCT retains set semantics. -->
    <xsl:text>SELECT DISTINCT </xsl:text><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="$focus = '?c1'"><xsl:text>?c1</xsl:text></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:text>(</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$focus"/><xsl:text> AS ?c1)</xsl:text></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose><xsl:text> ?lat ?lng ?point ?wkt ?title WHERE {
</xsl:text>
    <xsl:value-of select="mctx:compiled/mctx:where"/><xsl:text>
</xsl:text>
    <xsl:if test="contains($graph,':') and not(starts-with($graph,'$'))">
      <xsl:text>GRAPH <</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$graph"/><xsl:text>> {
</xsl:text>
    </xsl:if>
    <xsl:text>{
</xsl:text>
    <xsl:call-template name="alternatives">
      <xsl:with-param name="node" select="$or-list"/>
      <xsl:with-param name="focus" select="$focus"/>
      <xsl:with-param name="first" select="'true'"/>
    </xsl:call-template>
    <xsl:text>
} OPTIONAL { </xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$focus"/><xsl:text> <</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="concat($rdfs,'label')"/><xsl:text>> ?title . }
</xsl:text>
    <xsl:if test="contains($graph,':') and not(starts-with($graph,'$'))"><xsl:text>}
</xsl:text></xsl:if>
    <xsl:text>} ORDER BY ?c1 ?lat ?lng ?point ?wkt ?title LIMIT </xsl:text>
    <xsl:choose><xsl:when test="number($view/@limit) > 0"><xsl:value-of select="floor(number($view/@limit))"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise>101</xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose>
    <xsl:text> OFFSET </xsl:text>
    <xsl:choose><xsl:when test="number($view/@offset) >= 0"><xsl:value-of select="floor(number($view/@offset))"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise>0</xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose>
   </sparql>
   <facets>
    <xsl:for-each select="$view/../*[local-name()='property' or local-name()='property-of' or local-name()='class']">
     <xsl:variable name="direction">
      <xsl:choose><xsl:when test="local-name()='property-of'">reverse</xsl:when><xsl:when test="local-name()='class'">class</xsl:when><xsl:otherwise>forward</xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose>
     </xsl:variable>
     <facet id="{@id}" direction="{$direction}">
      <xsl:attribute name="iri"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="local-name()='class'">http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type</xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:value-of select="@iri"/></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:attribute>
     </facet>
    </xsl:for-each>
   </facets>
  </query-request>
 </xsl:template>

 <xsl:template name="alternatives">
  <xsl:param name="node"/><xsl:param name="focus"/><xsl:param name="first"/>
  <xsl:if test="$node != '' and $node != concat($rdf,'nil')">
   <xsl:variable name="first-triple" select="key('by-subject',$node)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($rdf,'first')]"/>
   <xsl:variable name="branch" select="string($first-triple/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
   <xsl:variable name="next-triple" select="key('by-subject',$node)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($rdf,'rest')]"/>
   <xsl:variable name="next" select="string($next-triple/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
   <xsl:if test="$first != 'true'"><xsl:text>
UNION
</xsl:text></xsl:if>
   <xsl:text>{
</xsl:text>
   <xsl:for-each select="key('by-subject',$branch)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($sh,'property')]">
    <xsl:variable name="property" select="string(s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
    <xsl:variable name="binding" select="string(key('by-subject',$property)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($mui,'mapBinding')]/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
    <xsl:variable name="path" select="key('by-subject',$property)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($sh,'path')]/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1]"/>
    <xsl:if test="string($path) != '' and ($binding='lat' or $binding='lng' or $binding='point' or $binding='wkt')">
     <xsl:value-of select="$focus"/><xsl:text> </xsl:text>
     <xsl:choose><xsl:when test="local-name($path)='uri'"><xsl:text><</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$path"/><xsl:text>></xsl:text></xsl:when>
      <xsl:otherwise><xsl:call-template name="sequence-path"><xsl:with-param name="node" select="string($path)"/></xsl:call-template></xsl:otherwise>
     </xsl:choose>
     <xsl:text> ?</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$binding"/><xsl:text> .
</xsl:text>
    </xsl:if>
   </xsl:for-each>
   <xsl:text>}</xsl:text>
   <xsl:call-template name="alternatives"><xsl:with-param name="node" select="$next"/><xsl:with-param name="focus" select="$focus"/><xsl:with-param name="first" select="'false'"/></xsl:call-template>
  </xsl:if>
 </xsl:template>

 <xsl:template name="sequence-path">
  <xsl:param name="node"/>
  <xsl:variable name="first" select="key('by-subject',$node)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($rdf,'first')]"/>
  <xsl:variable name="rest" select="key('by-subject',$node)[s:binding[@name='p']/s:uri=concat($rdf,'rest')]"/>
  <xsl:if test="string($first/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1]) != ''">
   <xsl:text><</xsl:text><xsl:value-of select="$first/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1]"/><xsl:text>></xsl:text>
   <xsl:variable name="next" select="string($rest/s:binding[@name='o']/*[1])"/>
   <xsl:if test="$next != concat($rdf,'nil') and $next != ''">
    <xsl:text>/</xsl:text><xsl:call-template name="sequence-path"><xsl:with-param name="node" select="$next"/></xsl:call-template>
   </xsl:if>
  </xsl:if>
 </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Map provider transformation. Geographic semantics and RDF result parsing
     live here; Maestro's query bridge supplies standard SPARQL Results XML. -->
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"
  xmlns:s="http://www.w3.org/2005/sparql-results#" exclude-result-prefixes="s">
 <xsl:output method="xml" omit-xml-declaration="yes"/>
 <xsl:template match="/s:sparql">
  <points><xsl:apply-templates select="s:results/s:result"/></points>
 </xsl:template>
 <xsl:template match="s:result">
  <xsl:variable name="uri" select="string(s:binding[@name='c1']/s:uri)"/>
  <xsl:variable name="lat-field" select="string(s:binding[@name='lat']/*[1])"/>
  <xsl:variable name="lng-field" select="string(s:binding[@name='lng']/*[1])"/>
  <xsl:variable name="point" select="normalize-space(translate(string(s:binding[@name='point']/*[1]),',',' '))"/>
  <xsl:variable name="wkt" select="string(s:binding[@name='wkt']/*[1])"/>
  <xsl:variable name="inside" select="normalize-space(substring-before(substring-after($wkt,'('),')'))"/>
  <xsl:variable name="lat">
   <xsl:choose>
    <xsl:when test="$lat-field != '' and $lng-field != ''"><xsl:value-of select="$lat-field"/></xsl:when>
    <xsl:when test="$point != ''"><xsl:value-of select="substring-before(concat($point,' '),' ')"/></xsl:when>
    <xsl:when test="contains(concat(' ',translate($wkt,'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz','ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')),' POINT') and contains($wkt,'(') and contains($wkt,')')"><xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(substring-after($inside,' '))"/></xsl:when>
   </xsl:choose>
  </xsl:variable>
  <xsl:variable name="lng">
   <xsl:choose>
    <xsl:when test="$lat-field != '' and $lng-field != ''"><xsl:value-of select="$lng-field"/></xsl:when>
    <xsl:when test="$point != ''"><xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(substring-after($point,' '))"/></xsl:when>
    <xsl:when test="contains(concat(' ',translate($wkt,'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz','ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')),' POINT') and contains($wkt,'(') and contains($wkt,')')"><xsl:value-of select="substring-before(concat($inside,' '),' ')"/></xsl:when>
   </xsl:choose>
  </xsl:variable>
  <xsl:if test="$uri != '' and string($lat) != '' and string($lng) != '' and number($lat) = number($lat) and number($lng) = number($lng) and number($lat) >= -90 and number($lat) <= 90 and number($lng) >= -180 and number($lng) <= 180">
   <point uri="{$uri}" lat="{$lat}" lng="{$lng}">
    <xsl:attribute name="title"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="s:binding[@name='title']/*[1]"><xsl:value-of select="s:binding[@name='title']/*[1]"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:value-of select="$uri"/></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:attribute>
   </point>
  </xsl:if>
 </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Provider-owned categorical palette. The source terms are RDF term keys,
     not display labels. Lexical sorting makes coloring stable across pagination. -->
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
 <xsl:output method="xml" omit-xml-declaration="yes"/>
 <xsl:template match="/palette">
  <xsl:variable name="terms" select="term[@key != '' and not(@key = preceding-sibling::term/@key)]"/>
  <colors>
   <xsl:for-each select="$terms">
    <xsl:sort select="@key"/>
    <xsl:variable name="h" select="20 + (360 * (position() - 1) div count($terms))"/>
    <xsl:variable name="sector" select="($h mod 360) div 60"/>
    <xsl:variable name="diff" select="($sector mod 2) - 1"/>
    <xsl:variable name="absdiff"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="$diff < 0"><xsl:value-of select="-$diff"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:value-of select="$diff"/></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:variable>
    <xsl:variable name="c" select="(1 - (1 - 0.86)) * 0.76"/>
    <xsl:variable name="x" select="$c * (1 - number($absdiff))"/>
    <xsl:variable name="m" select="0.43 - $c div 2"/>
    <xsl:variable name="r"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="$sector < 1"><xsl:value-of select="$c"/></xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 2"><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 4">0</xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 5"><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:value-of select="$c"/></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:variable>
    <xsl:variable name="g"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="$sector < 1"><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 3"><xsl:value-of select="$c"/></xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 4"><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise>0</xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:variable>
    <xsl:variable name="b"><xsl:choose><xsl:when test="$sector < 2">0</xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 3"><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:when><xsl:when test="$sector < 5"><xsl:value-of select="$c"/></xsl:when><xsl:otherwise><xsl:value-of select="$x"/></xsl:otherwise></xsl:choose></xsl:variable>
    <color key="{@key}">
     <xsl:attribute name="hex">#<xsl:call-template name="hex2"><xsl:with-param name="v" select="round((number($r)+$m)*255)"/></xsl:call-template><xsl:call-template name="hex2"><xsl:with-param name="v" select="round((number($g)+$m)*255)"/></xsl:call-template><xsl:call-template name="hex2"><xsl:with-param name="v" select="round((number($b)+$m)*255)"/></xsl:call-template></xsl:attribute>
    </color>
   </xsl:for-each>
  </colors>
 </xsl:template>
 <xsl:template name="hex2">
  <xsl:param name="v"/>
  <xsl:variable name="hex" select="'0123456789abcdef'"/>
  <xsl:value-of select="substring($hex, floor($v div 16) + 1, 1)"/>
  <xsl:value-of select="substring($hex, ($v mod 16) + 1, 1)"/>
 </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
